name: Doki Doki Love Stomp
source: A ridiculous wrestling dating sim! Play as Hulku-chan, a young Hogan-obsessed freshman attending Wrestling School. On her way to her first class on her first day, she runs into a mysterious, 8-foot-tall sophomore named Bully Demise and begins a journey of love, stomps, and heartbreak.
translation: 一个荒谬的摔跤约会模拟游戏！扮演Hulku-chan，一名痴迷霍根的摔跤学校新生。在第一天去上第一节课的路上，她遇到了一位神秘的、8英尺高的二年级学生，名叫“Bully Demise”，并开始了一段充满爱、跺脚和心碎的旅程。
